notes: scanServerDirectory reads eula.txt with its own inline check — eulaContent.contains("eula=true") against a `try? ... ?? ""` fallback (line 253-256) — rather than calling EULAManager.readEULA, which is the tri-state (true/false/nil) reader Phase 4's paper-import scan used (see fixtures/paper-import/missing-properties-use-minecraft-defaults.json, where a missing eula.txt yields eulaAccepted: null). Here a missing file coerces straight to false: an MSC 1 default, not genuinely-undetermined data. The substring check is also naive — any eula.txt whose content happens to contain the literal text "eula=true" anywhere (even mid-comment) reads as accepted, unlike EULAManager's per-line eula= prefix parse.
